messages:
Priya: quick check-in on NovaHealth onboarding — ran perf profile for last 48h, saw rising tail latencies during peak (18:00-20:00 UTC) and token cost spike.
Tom: thanks — any suspected cause?
Priya: two things: (1) their default model is a 13B fp16 variant with no quantization; (2) routing is currently round-robin -> lots of cross-region hops.
Elena: ...can we propose minimal-risk changes they can opt into?
Priya: yes. suggested plan:
- enable Redwood Optimize "latency-conservative" quantization to INT8 for the 13B model (expected 30-40% token cost reduction, ~10-20% latency improvement)
- add model fallback to a 7B quantized variant for <=256 token requests during peak hours
- route US-east traffic to dedicated pool in us-east1 and fallback to hosted only if capacity exhausted
Ravi: what's the rollback plan if quality degrades?
Priya: A/B rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 2 days with automatic quality regression alerts tied to their eval set (we already have a 200-prompt set from onboarding).
Samir: any config snippets we can drop into their onboarding guide?
Priya: posted below — quick routing + quant snippet they can apply via Console/CLI
```
# routing policy
{
  "route_by": "latency",
  "prefer": ["pool:us-east-dedicated"],
  "fallback": ["model:redwood-llama-7b-q8", "model:redwood-13b-int8"],
  "shards": {"max_latency_ms": 250}
}

# quant profile (Redwood Optimize)
apply_quantization --customer novahealth --model redwood-13b --profile latency-conservative --target int8
```
Tom: looks good. Concern: their CS contact said renewal conversation in 6 weeks — do we coordinate enablement to show cost savings before renewal?
Priya: yes, target to complete A/B and show telemetry within 3 weeks. I'll run a shortcase for CSM + AE.
Elena: I'll prepare a one-pager with expected unit economics and sample traces.
onboard-bot: Reminder: Schedule enablement session with NovaHealth — suggested slots: next Tue 14:00 or Thu 10:00 UTC.
Ravi: I'll take Tue 14:00.
deploy-bot: Note: If team triggers quantization apply, config will be scheduled during maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Priya: thanks all. I'll capture feedback after first 10k tokens and loop in product for any perf regressions.
Samir: ping me if we need to adjust production routing weights, I can modify policy on the fly.
Priya: closing — will update thread after A/B step 1.
